whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `ssl_verify` switch set to false.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix an `ssl_verify` switch set to false.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm .condarc no longer carries an `ssl_verify` switch set to false.
